isric_ph_telangana_0-5cm.tif is a tiny GeoTIFF subset retrieved from the
ISRIC SoilGrids 2.0 official WCS at latitude 17.68, longitude 78.18 for 0–5 cm
pH (mean). It is included only as a deterministic raster-parser test fixture.
SoilGrids is CC BY 4.0: https://isric.org/explore/soilgrids
Poggio et al. (2021), SOIL 7, 217–240, doi:10.5194/soil-7-217-2021.

The fixture omitted from the Markdown export was re-fetched from the official
ISRIC WCS on 2026-10-30 using coverageUrl('phh2o','0-5cm',17.68,78.18).
SHA-256: fc8828fb1cb1361e17ec857794304fd5329a18ccd223dc5991b3576ef9893217
This is a newly retrieved source fixture, not a claim of byte identity with the
original omitted file.
